name: orgo-teammates
description: Orgo Teammates: an open-source take on always-on AI teammates, built on public APIs (xAI, Orgo, Composio). Independent project, not affiliated with or endorsed by xAI.

scripts.dev: npm run dev -w server & npm run dev -w web
scripts.build: npm run build -w web && npm run build -w server
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w server && npm run typecheck -w web
